blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Nearly 2,000 residents of an interior village in Kitaotao town, Bukidnon province have been forced to wade across a river after a rusted foundation cable on their only hanging steel bridge snapped earlier this week. Panganan Barangay Captain Ramo Eredera told the Inquirer by phone that residents heard loud noises at dawn on November 24 and later discovered the bridge, which was constructed five years ago, leaning dangerously to one side.
